description: The pie chart shows the distribution of languages represented in “Paper: OpenAssistant Conversations — Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment,” displayed as a single pie divided into 10 slices. The largest slice is labeled English in dark blue at about 42.8%, followed by Spanish in a slightly lighter blue at about 31.4%. Smaller slices include Other in very light blue at about 5.8%, Russian in medium-light blue at about 5.7%, German in light blue at about 3.6%, French in lighter blue at about 2.9%, Chinese in pale blue at about 2.5%, Thai in very pale blue at about 1.9%, Portuguese (Brazil) in very pale blue at about 1.7%, and Japanese in the palest blue at about 1.6%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, labels are placed around the pie, there is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the slices visually proceed from the largest segments to progressively smaller ones around the chart.
